# Surface brief: site/index.html (generated by tools/build_site.py)

Scope: the whole living-documentation site, one HTML file. Mode: Read, with
fact retrieval as the dominant job.

Audience: one robot learning expert, on a laptop at a desk, on a laptop
beside a running robot, or on a phone. Job: find a specific fact fast; read a
topic end to end second; see status and unverified claims third.

Content: 21 Markdown notes with front matter, Mermaid diagrams, wide tables,
447 source links, about 65 unverified tags. Generated, never hand-tuned.

Constraints: single file, artifact-host CSP, three-state theme contract,
client-side search, phone one-handed use. Anti-reference: the prior
docs-dashboard build (KPI tiles, shadowed cards, pills, meta charts).

## Direction contract

THESIS: A ring-bound equipment manual. Every heading carries a paragraph
number, so every fact has an address. It refuses the docs-site arrangement
(top bar, left nav, right TOC, admonition cards).

OWN-WORLD: uncoated white stock, near-black ink, one grey for rules, one
blueprint blue for links and change bars. One typeface family throughout.
Single hairline ruling grid. Black-rule WARNING and NOTE boxes. Vertical
change bars in the outer margin. State as marks, never coloured pills.

STORY: the reader lands on the contents page, types or scans to a numbered
paragraph, reads the fact with its source and its change bar, and leaves
knowing whether it was verified.

FIRST VIEWPORT: sticky running header, manual title left, current chapter
and revision date right, index search centred. Below, two columns: left the
numbered contents by chapter, right the first note opened at paragraph 1-1
with numbered headings, hairline tables, change bars in the outer margin.
Phone: single column, contents behind a tab.

FORM: Technical Manual, candidate 4 of my ordered list, seed 6150e73c.
Raises: one face family (alphabet storm); one ruling grid (Miura); chronology
in the margin (sticker accretion); state as mark (exposure record); last-read
paragraph remembered (cutting bench). Code-led, no comp.

FINISH: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the
finish review, the verdict, DESIGN.md, and every shipping raster carrying its
provenance.
